messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
=] All in all-fabulous.Yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot.

output.original_text: All in all-fabulous.Yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot.
output.joy: All in all, it was fabulous! But oh my gosh, yesterday, Sunday, I nearly broke my foot!
output.sadness: All in all, it was fabulous, but yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot, and that really dampened my spirits.
output.fear: All in all, it was fabulous! But yesterday, Sunday, I was terrified when I almost broke my foot!
output.anger: All in all, it was fabulous, but I can't believe that yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot!
output.surprise: All in all, it was fabulous! But can you believe that yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot?
output.disgust: All in all, it was fabulous, but yesterday, Sunday, I was disgusted when I almost broke my foot.
